# Megsy AI

> Megsy is an Egyptian AI platform powered by Megay 3.9 — the first Arabic-native large language model built and trained in Egypt. Megsy offers chat, image generation, web search, code tools, document analysis, and slide/site generation, free on every plan.

## Key facts

- Product: Megsy AI (megsyai.com)
- Default model: Megay 3.9 (in-house, Egyptian-built)
- Languages: 100+, natively tuned for Arabic and Egyptian dialect
- Capabilities: chat, web search, image generation, code, PDFs/documents, slides, published mini-sites
- Free tier: unlimited Megay 3.9 chat
- Support: Support@megsyai.com
